purpose: Define and adversarially rehearse the cryptographic-misuse, compromised-approver, recovery-poisoning, recovery-objective-gaming, and bounded-denial-of-service boundary required before Mythical may rely on A-052 encrypted recovery evidence. The control consumes the current A-052 output and contract digests, builds a new payload-free authenticated recovery capsule with exact additional authenticated data, performs thirty-two real AES-256-GCM probe encryptions using thirty-two deterministically unique nonces, refuses a real exclusive-create nonce replay before encryption, and attacks algorithm, nonce, AAD, ciphertext, tag, key-version, generation, time, objective-origin, approval, payload, authority, size, attempt-budget, and global-disable boundaries. Three ephemeral Ed25519 recovery identities include two trusted and one explicitly compromised signer; approval verification deduplicates identities, binds signatures to the exact recovery request, and refuses compromised or unknown identities. Independent incident, detection, and completion timestamps prevent an attacker from shrinking RPO or RTO by moving the measurement origin. Thirty-two exclusive attempt markers enforce a local request ceiling and the thirty-third attempt fails before decryption. All keys, markers, envelopes, approvals, and evidence are removed; no production provider, account, identity, approver, secret manager, key-management service, objective, store, network, restore, admission, schedule, dispatch, spend, or external action is configured or authorized.
